status: Before new broad-band cross-convolution numerical outcomes; original five-band ages and native pixel inventory already inspected. No age fitting authorized.
scope: Input inventory and bounded response remedy validation only; no stellar likelihood result.
density: G convolves lambda*F_lambda in log wavelength and divides by output lambda; finite quadrature G_ij=delta_lambda_j/lambda_i times normalized Gaussian in ln(lambda_i/lambda_j). Truncate at5sigma; preserve this explicit matrix, no row renormalization.
mask: Released mask==0, finite flux and positiveIVAR; all FSPS nebular centres +/-400km/s; output G row retained only if every nonzero contributing input pixel is valid. Same fixed native-camera cuts5780/7570 applied to output rows, not input smoothing support.
units: Every broad vector entry uses signed native F_lambda density; not a Lick index or identical to former Fnu break measurements.
coverage: Keep a band only when at least95% of its geometric width is sampled before masks and remaining weight is nonzero; retain every host and all dropped-window reasons. No SNR selection.
family: All70 existing SSPs times7 existing tauV/power combinations; all are numerical test spectra. They are not fitted to observations.
foreground: Forward F99Rv3.1, nativeEBV*.86; no observed de-reddening.
operator: Synthetic truth f uses existing resolved SSPs. Compare W G R D f to W R D G f, with D containing host+foreground attenuation and redshift density factor. Both side orderings explicit; no DESI R normalization. This is a library-kernel assumption test, not proof about unknown finer spectra.
covariance: C=W G diag(1/IVAR) G^T W^T; same pixels, masks and arms; full matrix retained.
amplitude: For each test column only, use positive measured reference-band mean divided by its model mean to express response error at observed flux scale. This is a numerical scale setting, not an age/SFH fit.
narrow_line_stress: Report worst commutator error for a1-observed-Angstrom-equivalent-width unresolved line at every native input pixel, scaled by the measured reference continuum; not an empirical line-strength prior.
identification_limits: No SFH/clock prior or age fit here.
Current library kernel is approximate; signed native response second moments do not define a Gaussian replacement.
Passage under finite synthetic family does not validate missing sharper structure, DR1 multi-exposure coaddition, calibration covariance or stellar abundance completeness.
Failing response gates must remain explicit; no post-outcome retuning.
